mapper.select: select pos_id as positionId, pos_title as title, pos_department as department, cast(pos_jd_json as char) as jdJson from t_pos where pos_id = #{posId}
select psk_id as skillId, psk_name as name, psk_required as required from t_pos_skill where psk_position_id = #{posId} order by psk_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_pos_skill (psk_position_id, psk_name, psk_required) values (#{posId}, #{name}, #{required})
